sources.name: IBGE, Evolução da divisão territorial do Brasil 1872–2010

coverage: Official IBGE geometry is retained for source years. Earlier dates merge later divisions into captaincies or provinces, without claiming surveyed early frontiers. Cisplatina uses current Uruguay as a proxy. The 1934 political period uses 1933 state geometry and no anachronistic municipal overlay. Fernando de Noronha is a state district of Pernambuco in the 1991 source, not a 27th state. Indigenous nations, effective settlement and occupation are not represented.
